abstraction_note.explicitly_not: no measured historical mean is claimed for any turn value

abstraction_note.propagation: modeled as zero at game scale; distance only selects the medium
abstraction_note.source: history: same-navy tactical traffic is a handling/encoding/relay/queue problem, not propagation; TBS short signals can complete inside one turn while coded W/T through a message centre takes materially longer

blackout.description: no delivery is possible; the message is never sent
blackout.label: SIMULATION_ABSTRACTION

blinker.description: direct visual; same or +1 turn, +1 per repeated-down stage

face_to_face.description: same command location: spoken, no radio event and no channel slot
face_to_face.label: SIMULATION_ABSTRACTION

multi_hop.description: compound route; the total may reach t+2
multi_hop.label: SIMULATION_ABSTRACTION

tbs_short.description: short tactical signal; same turn if the channel is free
tbs_short.label: SIMULATION_ABSTRACTION
